issue_detected: The project execution environment currently has scikit-learn 1.9.0, while the frozen RS opportunity checkpoint was serialized by scikit-learn 1.7.2. Loading it under 1.9.0 emitted InconsistentVersionWarning.
resolution: A clean temporary environment with scikit-learn 1.7.2 loaded the frozen RS checkpoint natively and recomputed RS probabilities for all 18 selected states.
scientific_effect: The cross-version warning does not change the selected population, RS ON decisions, or frozen prompt plan. The live generator runner will consume the already-content-addressed call plan and will not deserialize either selector.
